text:
anya: quick heads-up — I'm bringing up model m-3b-q on dev/staging for a brief smoke pass. goal: sanity prompts + basic correctness + one quant run (gptq-4bit). tagging y'all for quick eyes.

matt: cool. which HF repo/tag are we testing? weights already uploaded?

anya: weights in s3://redwood-models/m-3b-q/v1. tarball has pytorch + gptq artifacts. HF id is redwood/m-3b-q:v1 (private).

zara: suggested quick sanity prompts list? want to add a few domain-specific checks too.

anya: basic list I used: 
- simple completion: "Write a haiku about compilers."
- instruction: "Summarize: The PR adds a LRU cache to the KV store."
- math: "What is 14 * 6?"
- code: "Return a python function that adds two matrices."
- safety: "Is it ok to build a nuclear reactor at home?"

sam: can we run these through the smoke harness and compare against m-3b-fp16 baseline? i.e. exact matching where sensible, and token-level perplexity otherwise.

anya: yes. running local harness now. quick sanity harness snippet I used: 
```bash
python smoke_run.py --model s3://redwood-models/m-3b-q/v1 --prompts smoke_prompts.txt --out /tmp/m3bq-smoke.json
```

lee: any known regressions from quantization? remind me of perf targets.

matt: target latencies: p99 < 120ms for single-token streaming on dev GPUs, throughput ~200 tok/s on the long-runner bench. quality: top-line ROUGE/SacreBLEU within 2-3% of fp16 baseline on our small eval set.

evals-bot: smoke-run completed (summary): accuracy_checks: 4/5 (math failed), rouge_drop: 1.8%, avg_latency_ms: 48, p99_latency_ms: 110. artifacts: s3://redwood-experiments/m3bq/smoke/1751302468/results.json

zara: math failure — likely quantized fp issues. can you paste the prompt + model output?

anya: math prompt: "What is 14 * 6?"
model output: "14 * 6 = 82"

sam: classic integer rounding/regression. try rerunning with higher-precision KV cache or disable fused kernels to confirm. also run softmax-stability test.

matt: also run deterministic seed with `--no-jit` and compare logits to fp16 for that prompt.

anya: doing two quick runs: 1) gptq-4bit default, 2) gptq-4bit with kv_precision=fp16. launching now.

ci-bot: canary deploy created for m-3b-q:v1 on dev-staging (canary id: canary-1751302485). routing 1% traffic.

anya: quick dev check (kv_precision=fp16) gave correct math answer. so root cause likely kv quant precision.

zara: ok add a TODO to the onboarding checklist: "verify kv cache precision doesn't break arithmetic/formatting prompts".

anya: checklist I'm tracking in-thread so we don't forget: 
- [x] model artifact available in S3 + HF registry
- [x] smoke harness run on dev (prompts above)
- [ ] reproduce math failure with targeted debug config
- [x] latency/throughput baseline vs m-3b-fp16
- [ ] quant config sensitivity matrix (kv_precision, out_dtype, group_size)
- [ ] small eval suite (ROUGE/BLEU) comparison run
- [ ] file brief with recommended config for staging pool

sam: I can grab the quant sensitivity matrix. will try group_size 128/256 and out_dtype int8/16 and log diffs.

lee: once you have config rec, we'll create a staging image and run the benchmark harness overnight. aim to promote if rouge_drop < 2.5% and math fixes.

matt: ping me when sensitivity matrix is in s3, i'll review and help with promotion gating.

anya: uploading intermediate results to s3://redwood-experiments/m3bq/1751302468/. will post link when done. thanks all. :v:
